## Core Product Categories

### 1. Cleaning Supplies & Detergents
- Floor cleaners, bleach, laundry detergents, dishwashing soaps, air fresheners, and pest control.
- Brands: Sano, Jacobi, and other leading professional brands.

### 2. Paper Products
- Industrial paper rolls, paper towels (Z-fold/C-fold), toilet paper packs, and hand towels.
- Brands: Kimberly-Clark, Perach, and other industrial suppliers.

### 3. Single-Use Packaging & Food Service
- Plastic & paper cups, plates, cutlery, food bags, and takeaway containers.

### 4. Office Supplies & Stationery
- A4/A3 copy paper (colored and white), folders, laminating pouches, markers, pens, and binders.
